troubleshooting.title: Why are certain assets or databases missing from my reports?
troubleshooting.shortdesc: Some assets or databases may not appear in if they do not have enough data or use restricted settings.

condition.p: An asset is active in but does not appear in reports or benchmarks.

cause.p: MyGeotab excludes certain devices to keep your fleet data accurate. An asset or database may be missing if it meets any of these conditions:

li.p: Low activity: The asset has not driven at least 50 km in the last 7 days.
No communication: The device has not sent data to in the last month.
New database: The database is less than one month old.
Privacy: The device is set to Restricted Data Mode.
Device type: The asset is an unsupported OEM, or uses a third-party, or Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) device. For a list of supported OEM devices, see .
Small fleet: The database has fewer than two active devices.

p.note: Even without a fleet benchmark, individual asset and driver ranks are still available in that database.

step.cmd: Check your device settings to make sure they are not in Restricted Data Mode.
If your database is new, wait until the one-month mark for data to appear.
Make sure your assets drive at least 50 km each week to stay active in reports.
